title: Man and the Computer by John G. Kemeny (1972 book by the co-creator of BASIC)
summary: A 1972 book by John G. Kemeny, co-creator of BASIC programming language, exploring the relationship between humans and computers, their roles, and the societal implications of computing technology.
problem_solved: Provides philosophical and practical perspectives on human-computer interaction and the role of computers in society.
why_valuable: Offers insights from a computing pioneer that remain relevant for understanding the human-computer relationship and the social impact of technology.
